scripts.start: UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run new-sandbox:mem" "sleep 5 && npm run start:ui"
scripts.start:clone: UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run new-sandbox:mem:clone" "sleep 5 && npm run start:ui"
scripts.new-sandbox:mem: RUST_LOG=info WASM_LOG=debug echo "pass" | ../../bin/hc s --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT generate ../../artifacts/playground.happ --run=$HC_APP_PORT -a playground network mem
scripts.new-sandbox:mem:clone: RUST_LOG=info WASM_LOG=debug echo "pass" | ../../bin/hc s --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT generate ../../artifacts/playground-clone.happ --run=$HC_APP_PORT -a playground-clone network mem
